unit.title: Cutting and making skirts
unit.needIt: Knowing how to cut and sew a skirt helps you make your own clothes that fit perfectly. It saves you money and lets you fix your favorite pieces instead of throwing them away.
unit.why: A dressmaker wants to make a beautiful silk skirt without ruining the fabric. She learns that using the wrong iron or pulling a thread too hard can destroy a garment in seconds. By following the right steps for pressing and basting, she ensures the skirt stays perfect.
unit.outcome: Create a professional skirt by correctly cutting, pressing, and basting fabric.
unit.reachesYou: You see these skills when you notice a perfectly hemmed skirt in a shop. You also feel them when you try to iron a shirt at home and worry about burning it.
unit.do: Practice pressing a piece of fabric with a wet cloth and a hot iron to see how it smooths out.

quiz.q: What is the best way to remove basting threads from delicate fabric like silk?
quiz.why: The text says to clip them in small sections to avoid ruining the fabric.
quiz.quote: The better way is to clip in small sections before removing.

quiz.q: How should you press woolen goods to avoid making them shiny?
choices: Use a wet cloth and sponge
quiz.why: The text suggests using a wet cloth and a sponge to avoid marks.
quiz.quote: To press Woolens, lay a wet cloth, preferably cotton, on the garment just where you want it pressed.

quiz.q: What should you do to shrink white wash goods?
quiz.why: The instructions say to put the material in a pan of cold water and let it boil.
quiz.quote: Lay the material in a pan of cold water and let come to a boil.

quiz.q: How should you handle a skirt while basting it?
choices: Lay it flat on a table
quiz.why: The text warns that holding the skirt will cause the seams to stretch.
quiz.quote: Do not hold a skirt, or any full length garment, in your hands while basting it.

quiz.q: What is the purpose of using a piece of cambric for side seams?
quiz.why: The text explains that any seam with bias must be stayed to prevent stretching.
quiz.quote: Any seam in a full length garment where there is bias must be stayed.
